payload.title: R1: Write the S (one-line) and F (excerpted full guideline) prompts per candidate
payload.description:
## Purpose

Write the two screening prompts per candidate: S (one-line simplified rubric) and F (excerpted full guideline).

## Scope

- S: one line per dataset naming the labels with a plain one-sentence gloss (what a newcomer would write without reading the guideline). Same output format as F.
- F: the published guideline excerpted to stay under ~25k tokens (Jev request limit ~64k total, ~32k state); keep definitions, decision rules and boundary cases first; record every cut (section, reason, tokens removed).
- Exact wording committed under `studies/` (e.g. `studies/rubric_screening/<dataset>/{S,F}.txt` plus `cuts.md`), with sha256 recorded; labels and output format identical across S and F (compare like with like).
- Respect licenses from R0 (do not commit guideline text whose terms forbid redistribution: store a pointer + hash instead and say so).

## Definition of done

Prompt files and cut logs committed for each candidate that passed R0; token counts recorded; reviewed by the main session.

## Cost

$0 (no model calls).
